global_style.art_style: Photorealistic cinematic horror imagery. Every image prompt must independently describe the complete visual: subjects, clothing, appearance, environment, action, camera framing, lighting and atmosphere. Do not use references to previous images, movie scenes, iconic scenes or named fictional characters as substitutes for visual descriptions. A terrifying recurring clown has chalk-white makeup, bright orange-red hair, yellowish eyes, an unnaturally wide smile and an antique grey-white clown costume with orange-red pom-poms. A recurring young boy wears a bright yellow raincoat. A recurring teenage group consists of seven distinct teenagers in authentic late-1980s clothing. Maintain their visual appearances consistently. Use different camera angles, close-ups, reaction shots, action shots and environmental details. Each beat should represent a different moment, approximately 2–3 seconds long. The hand-drawn stickman presenter has a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie. Include him only when useful, positioned away from the main action.
global_style.negative_prompt: Cartoon, anime, illustration, toy-like clown, generic happy circus clown, colourful children's art, flat vector graphics, low-resolution, blurry, duplicate characters, inconsistent faces, modern clothing, modern cars, distorted hands, extra limbs, text, captions, watermark, logo, excessive gore, graphic injury, static slideshow compositions.
